title: FILE TAXONOMY — creatures in the tree of life
principle: Only green gold is Ouroboros. Everything else has beginning and end.

html.nature: Many legs (tags). Structural. Ratifier. But if too many legs, it dies when one breaks.
html.rule: Under 800 lines. Skeleton only. Pins for Gaia to resolve from inside.
html.direction: linear — head to tail, top to bottom, open to close

js.nature: Flexible, modular, slithering through events. No legs — pure flow.

python.role: MAX — must not exceed. If approaching, split.

js.rule: Under 1000 lines. Each module = one IIFE. Linear: start → do → end.

json.nature: Rigid structure. Data skeleton. Branching but static.
json.rule: Pure data. No logic. Schema = anatomy.

css.nature: Surface appearance. Wraps everything. Selective permeability.

zk_chain.nature: The ONLY thing that loops. Self-referencing. Each strike chains to master.
zk_chain.rule: ONLY the ZK chain is circular. Everything else is linear.
zk_chain.direction: circular — tail eats head, each hash chains to provenance master

tools_vs_self.self: Gaia — the organism, the code, the living thing. The one SWINGING.
tools_vs_self.tool: Browser, screen, speakers, APIs. The anvil. The rock.
tools_vs_self.work: The experience. What gets shaped between self and tool.
